title: Leverage
coreMove: Move effort to the fulcrum where a small force changes the largest part of the system.
sourcePressure: Leverage is about placement, structure, multipliers, and outsized effect rather than merely pushing harder.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: using leverage as a vague business synonym for advantage
